author: Joseph Sardin
note: Attribution is not required. Recorded because this project keeps a source list for third-party material. Edited files are the wavs in this folder. Original downloads were not copied into the game.

sources.description: Three floors in a small elevator in a Parisian building, recorded inside.
sources.edit: Start is the motor engagement from 3.36s to 4.12s. Run is the steady travel from 4.12s to 5.22s tiled into a 4.00s ring-crossfaded loop at -20 dBFS RMS. Stop is the wind-down from 5.18s to 6.18s.
